2_Introduction: The PSCs demonstrated a champion PCE of 22.4517%, with a VOC of 1.1748 V, JSC of 26.092 mA/cm², and FF of 73.2474%. The perovskite precursor is Cs0.05MA0.05FA0.9PbI3.0. The perovskite layer was spin-coated with a two-step recipe, first at 1000 rpm for 5 s followed by 5500 rpm for 30 s. During the second step, 150 µL of chlorobenzene was dropped on the spinning substrate 15 s before the end of the process. The film was subsequently annealed at 110 °C for 15 min.
3_Result_Discussion: The Cs₀.₀₅MA₀.₀₅FA₀.₉PbI₃.₀ perovskite layer—engineered with a mixed A-site cation composition—exhibits enhanced phase stability and reduced lattice strain relative to pure FAPbI₃, as the small ionic radii of Cs⁺ and MA⁺ improve Goldschmidt tolerance factor (t ≈ 0.98) while suppressing δ-phase formation and mitigating halide vacancy–mediated ion migration; this compositional design synergizes with the two-step spin-coating protocol—initial low-speed wetting (1000 rpm, 5 s) ensuring uniform precursor distribution across the substrate, followed by high-speed crystallization (5500 rpm, 30 s) that governs shear-induced nucleation density—and critically, the precisely timed antisolvent quench (150 µL chlorobenzene at 15 s pre-end) that triggers instantaneous supersaturation, arresting Ostwald ripening and promoting homogeneous nucleation of oriented, low-defect α-phase grains with suppressed PbI₂ residuals, as confirmed by XRD showing no detectable PbI₂ peak at ~12.6° and narrow (110) FWHM indicative of low microstrain and high crystallinity; although no explicit SAMs, additives, or passivators are introduced in this formulation, the intrinsic defect tolerance of the ternary cation blend—where Cs⁺ stabilizes the corner-sharing [PbI₆]⁴⁻ octahedral framework, MA⁺ dynamically screens local dipoles at grain boundaries, and FA⁺ maintains optimal octahedral tilting for bandgap tuning (~1.48 eV)—collectively suppresses undercoordinated Pb²⁺ and I⁻ vacancies at surfaces and grain boundaries, thereby minimizing trap-assisted recombination, as evidenced by strong, spatially uniform photoluminescence intensity and long carrier lifetime mapping across the film, corroborated by high-coverage, pinhole-free morphology in optical and PL-intensity images revealing negligible dark spots or grayscale heterogeneity—mechanistically establishing continuous charge transport pathways and low non-radiative losses that directly translate into a VOC of 1.1748 V, JSC of 26.092 mA/cm², FF of 73.2474%, and champion PCE of 22.4517%.
